record.reason: LEGOSim runs heterogeneous chiplet simulators as parallel simlets, with on-demand synchronization and decoupled communication modeling. Validation against SIMBA and a CiM accelerator reports simulation error below 10%; case studies explore interconnect, buffer, topology and memory design. It is a general architecture simulation framework, not an LLM inference optimization or LLM-specific evaluation; linked NPU/PIM lineage is indirect.
record.title: LEGOSim: A Unified Parallel Simulation Framework for Multi-chiplet Heterogeneous Integration
